original_record.question: A shape is made by cutting all the corners off a cube, as shown in the diagram. How many edges does the shape have? <image1>
original_record.solution: A cube has 12 edges, but truncating each of the 8 corners will create 3 extra edges at each one. Hence the new shape has $12+8 \times 3=36$ edges.
